sources.title: Architecture graph for brandonmusic/GLM-5.2-NVFP4-REAP-Recall-N172.
sources.snippet: The feed-forward layers use a mixture-of-experts design with 172 experts (8 active per token, 1 always-on). It has a vocabulary of 154,880 tokens and a context window of up to 1,048,576 tokens, in bfloat16 precision. Model type glm_moe_dsa Layers 78 Hidden size 6,144 Attention multi-head latent attention (MLA) Feed-forward

sources.title: GLM-5.2-NVFP4-REAP-Recall-N172 - friendli.ai
sources.snippet: Standard REAP compresses GLM-5.2 well for code, agentic, and reasoning workloads — but closed-book factual recall collapses: the published narrow-calibrated REAPs answer Lexington for the capital of Kentucky and loop on Marbury v. Madison. The cause is not the model and not the serving stack — it's a calibration corpus that excludes knowledge.

sources.title: GLM-5.2-Reap — recall-recovery recipe + serving stack
sources.snippet: A recall-recovering re-REAP of GLM-5.2-NVFP4 to 172 experts/layer, plus the verified Docker image, launch script, and saliency methodology to reproduce it.
